authority.architect_role: gate owner and reviewer. The architect specified, reviewed and froze this stage; the architect is NOT the approver.
authority.assistant_role: operator. Executes exactly what this file freezes, once, and nothing else.
authority.scope: exactly ONE J8 fit attempt. This file authorises nothing else whatsoever.

what_is_authorised.description: one invocation of the frozen J8 runner, in the frozen environment, with the frozen argv, writing to the single frozen leaf
what_is_authorised.retry: NONE. Whatever the outcome, there is no second attempt, no alternate leaf, no changed argument and no autonomous recovery.

frozen_inputs_note: a pure path -> sha256 map, relative to the V26C validation root. Any byte of difference invalidates this authorisation.

frozen_execution.output_root_override: MUST BE UNSET. The runner refuses the authorised fit while it is set; the override exists for synthetic isolated tests only and always marks a result non-authoritative.
frozen_execution.no_other_flag: no flag may be added, removed or altered

prerequisites_already_observed.note: observed independently before this authorisation was written; they are recorded as facts of that observation, not as promises
prerequisites_already_observed.fresh_process_preflight: GO, no blockers, read_only true, torch_imported_by_preflight false
prerequisites_already_observed.snapshot: 204 files hashed before and after the fresh preflight, byte-identical

immediately_before_execution.rerun_the_fresh_preflight: must still be GO, with no blockers
immediately_before_execution.reconfirm_absence: no J8 leaf, no lock, no staging directory
immediately_before_execution.on_any_mismatch: DO NOT EXECUTE. Stop and report.

integrity_or_precondition_abort.meaning: a binding precondition or integrity invariant failed before the commit
integrity_or_precondition_abort.expected_state: NO leaf is created; nothing is written
integrity_or_precondition_abort.action: STOP and diagnose. No retry, no leaf, no second attempt.

outcome_fail.meaning: the fit completed but a binding outcome failed - recovery RMSE did not decrease, or a controller column norm is not strictly positive
outcome_fail.expected_state: the leaf is committed atomically with verdict FAIL; the process exits 1
outcome_fail.action: PRESERVE the committed FAIL evidence exactly as written. STOP and diagnose. No retry.

pass.meaning: every binding precondition, integrity invariant and outcome held
pass.expected_state: the leaf is committed with verdict PASS; the process exits 0
pass.action: PRESERVE the evidence and hand back to the architect for independent audit.
pass.confers_nothing: a PASS is an offline result and authorises NOTHING further

a_pass_does_not_authorise: any change to FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin

standing_invariants.lineage: July is METHODOLOGY ONLY. The operational lineage is the AUGUST V26 J2 parent (module_state 0f182ea9f8939e2b7824e85c12c57343309c444680682b9bce5858dd74f9d130) and the CURRENT J7 dataset (bb9b21f029063562bc0229fcc6601dd98e19d071f115811f7d8cb918be852e27, 16713 rows). No July artefact is a parent, dataset, label or output.
standing_invariants.actor: one 35D actor. NO standalone 25D artefact, NO widening, NO contralateral inputs.
standing_invariants.backend: torch deterministic-algorithms and thread count are NOT forced by J8. Their observed values are diagnostic and non-binding, recorded with forced_by_j8 false.
standing_invariants.multistart_training_data: DEFERRED and absent. Not to be confused with the future multistart CLOSED-LOOP validation, which is a different and equally future thing.
standing_invariants.unchanged: no J0-J7 artefact, no July source, no report, no config and no production code is modified by this stage

this_authorisation_does_not: modify the runner, the preregistration or the tests
modify any J0-J7 artefact, July source, report or configuration
grant a second attempt under any circumstance
permit a different leaf, interpreter, cwd or argv
confer deployability, promotion or a next stage
